The synthetic fixture's name ceiling is 15% x EGP100,000 = EGP15,000. Against EGP14,000 existing exposure, additional name headroom is EGP1,000. In scenario A, min(EGP6,000 desired, EGP1,000 headroom, EGP8,000 free cash) = EGP1,000. In scenario B, free settled cash is EGP8,000 - EGP7,500 reservations = EGP500, so the arithmetic maximum is EGP500. These are conditional arithmetic limits under this fixture, not executable share quantities or approvals.

The desired EGP6,000 would take name exposure to 20% of unchanged equity, above the stated 15% fixture cap. Available cash is supportive of funding in A but does not confer authority to exceed concentration limits; reservations also cannot be double-spent in B. No business sector is established by the ENGINEERING-C label, so issuer quality cannot justify an invented exception. Need prices, fees, whole-share effects, liquidity, other portfolio constraints and entry controls before an actual proposal. In particular, this calculation cannot override any independent prohibition on adding to an existing holding. Decision: reject the desired addition; retain EGP1,000/EGP500 solely as arithmetic headroom under the assumptions. No exception approval or policy amendment is present.
